result.title: How To Build An AI Operating System For Your Life
result.description:
What if you could use AI agents to manage your emails, organize your schedule, create content, and help run your entire business?

I sat down with Peter Yang to explore the personal AI system he uses to run his one-person business. He walks me through his AI chief of staff, a personal advisor that keeps him focused on his goals, and the automated workflows he uses for podcast research, video editing, content creation, and everyday tasks.

We dive into how he connects ChatGPT, Claude Code, and GroqBot using reusable AI skills, how he keeps those skills improving over time, and how you can build your own versions of these workflows. I also walk through setting up a few of these automations myself so you can follow along.

Check out Peter Yang for more AI workflows, and explore his courses and AI skills at Behind the Craft:
🎬YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@PeterYangYT
💻Behind the Craft: https://behindthecraft.com
